info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Push Deactivation API
info.description: The Transaction Push Deactivation API allows users to disable transaction push notifications for specific accounts tied to a customer. By issuing a DELETE request, users can seamlessly manage notification preferences, ensuring they receive the relevant alerts necessary to their operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application developers looking to enhance user experience by customizing alert settings. This enhances client communication while reducing unnecessary notifications.

delete.summary: Remove transaction push configuration for a specific account.
delete.description: This operation deletes the transaction push settings for the account ACC-200045 associated with customer CUST-100045. Ensure that you understand the implications of this action as it will permanently remove the associated configurations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for the deletion of transaction push notifications for a specific account. Ensure that the request is authorized and that the transaction push notifications exist before attempting to delete them.
